text_block_list.text:
And so, the first three years with Super 
Creek came to a close.

The caring Umamusume and the rookie 
Trainer have now come to be known as a 
top-tier duo.
—At the Debut Race venue.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so many people called out to me, what 
should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Who should I ask? Hmm, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Aah, you're Super Creek-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Could you give me some advice on choosing 
a trainer? I'm having trouble deciding who 
to ask.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my. Did a lot of people come up to 
talk to you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There are plenty of folks, from 
those who look like they'd whip you into 
shape to those who seem super 
knowledgeable.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I wonder what kind of Trainer I 
should choose for my future."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, for the sake of the future...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then that's easy♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's choose a partner like this: Someone 
you can truly work hard for.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, *I'm* the one who has to work hard? 
Not you working hard for my sake, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is better to place more value on 
giving than receiving.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If it means we can keep running together 
forever. Right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I never even considered it. Something 
like that...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer♪ No, we were just chatting for 
a bit.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, see you later♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, must be nice~, Super Creek-senpai. 
Getting scouted by a genius Trainer like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"She said ‘it's better to give than to 
receive,’ but there's no way any trainer 
would give that much to me."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did you hear that? They called you a 
"genius Trainer."
choice_data_list: I was just an ordinary talent, though.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all~ She must have been 
a genius.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's just that a genius needed a little 
time to truly become a genius...
choice_data_list:
Did you think I was a genius from the 
start?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's see... What do you think...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's perfectly fine♪ Whether I'm 
a genius or just ordinary.”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Will you stay by my side for a long, long 
time to come, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My desire to do something for you hasn't 
changed in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, on the contrary, it might be even 
stronger than at the beginning.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll take you up on that offer.
Yeah, I'll take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much~ As expected, 
your choices are always top-notch, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Choosing someone you truly want to do 
something for. After all... Umamusume are 
meant to give♪

This year, too, many Umamusume to be 
nurtured are enrolling at Tracen Academy.

Still, the only Umamusume who would raise 
their own Trainer is Super Creek.
